protocol: Book queries are paraphrases that avoid the concept's key term. Gold pages = pages of the target document whose extracted text matches gold_regex at least min_hits times (computed by scripts/rag/eval_rag.py and saved with the results). This definition is lexical, so it can favour BM25; paraphrased queries limit that bias. Rule queries paraphrase one rule definition; gold = that rule's chunk.

book_queries.query: a candle with a tiny body near the top and a long lower shadow appearing after a decline
two-candle reversal where the second real body completely wraps around the prior body
bearish two-candle top where a white candle is followed by a black candle closing deep into its body
three-candle bottom reversal with a small middle candle gapping below a long black candle
three-candle top pattern with a small star after a long white candle
session where the open and the close are the same price, showing indecision
candle after a rally with a long upper shadow and a small body near the low
small real body contained within the previous large real body
matching highs or lows on consecutive sessions marking a minor turning point
a price gap between sessions that later acts as support or resistance in Japanese terminology
two-candle bottom where a white candle opens below the prior low and closes above the midpoint of the black body
three consecutive long black candles with lower closes after a rally
continuation pattern: long white candle, a few small declining candles inside its range, then another strong white candle
momentum oscillator comparing average gains and losses over fourteen periods bounded between zero and one hundred
difference between a twelve-period and a twenty-six-period exponential average with a nine-period signal line
volatility measure taking the greatest of the high-low range and the gaps from the prior close, then averaged
bands placed two standard deviations above and below a twenty-day average
oscillator locating the close within the recent high-low range, with %K and %D lines
buying when price exceeds the highest high of the last twenty days, the turtle-style entry
how many shares to trade so that a stop-out loses a fixed fraction of equity
testing a system on data it was not optimised on, rolling the optimisation window forward
indicator of trend strength built from directional movement, plus and minus DI
cumulative volume added on up days and subtracted on down days
reversal formation with a higher peak between two lower shoulders and a neckline
price levels where buying interest has previously halted a decline
converging trendlines with a flat top and rising bottoms
short consolidation sloping against a sharp move, a continuation pattern
rounded bottom followed by a small pullback before the breakout
two peaks at roughly the same price separated by a trough
narrowing pattern with both trendlines sloping the same direction
placing an order that exits the position automatically to cap the loss
the ratio between what a trade could gain and what it could lose
line connecting successive higher lows in a rising market
excess return per unit of total volatility as a performance measure
the set of portfolios with the highest expected return for each level of risk
model relating expected return to market beta and the risk-free rate
closed-form price of a European call under lognormal stock prices
loss threshold not exceeded with a given confidence over a horizon
rule for differentiating functions of a stochastic process
study of past prices and volume to anticipate future price moves rather than company accounts

rule_queries.query: only use a signal after the bar that formed it has finished
prefer longs when weekly swings make higher peaks and higher troughs
daily close above a prior confirmed swing high establishes bullish continuation
bullish candle body swallowing the previous body at a support area
long lower wick candle after a selloff near support, enter above its high
a bar inside the previous bar's range; trade only the break of the parent
close above the highest high of the preceding bars, excluding the current bar
after breaking out, wait for price to come back to the level and hold above it
momentum oscillator crossing back above its midline with improving price structure
price makes a lower low while the oscillator makes a higher low at confirmed pivots
band width compression; direction must come from price acceptance
cancel when the actual fill price makes the stop geometry or net payoff unacceptable
candidate must pass every mandatory gate before an order is submitted
place the protective stop beyond the swing whose failure invalidates the idea
trail a long position below the highest high minus a multiple of average true range
a protective stop may tighten but must never be moved further away to avoid a loss
use the nearest material opposing swing or zone as the first profit objective
close the trade when the predeclared maximum holding period is reached
after an adverse opening gap, model the exit at the first executable price, not the stop price
stop opening positions after the predefined daily loss threshold is hit
